messages:
emma (AE): Morning — quick async pipeline check. Yesterday: demo w/ KestrelPros went well; they like Dedicated but have on‑prem HSM/KMS and auditing asks. Blocker: need a short security doc showing keywrap + audit flow. Today: request @rachel to confirm HSM support details, @leo to prep solution runbook, and eng to triage PR #4321 (provisioning/autoscale). TL;DR: pilot could slip without those two items.
tyler (AM): thx emma. can you paste the exact KMS asks they listed? any FedRAMP/IL4 stuff?
emma (AE): they want HSM-backed key wrapping, customer-managed keys or BYOH option, key rotation policy ~30d, and searchable audited key usage logs. no FedRAMP yet, but they asked for SOC2 + ISO certs.
rachel (Security): noted. we have a KMS whitepaper but missing an HSM keywrap diagram + statement on audit retention. i'll draft a one‑pager today (ETA 1600 PT). Q: do they need vendor HSM or BYOH? please confirm.
leo (Solutions): i'll join the follow-up with their infra folks at 11:30 PT to clarify BYOH vs Redwood-managed HSM. will also attach our private deploy brief.
emma (AE): @rachel please include whether audited usage can stream to their SIEM or if we only ship logs to S3. @eng-oncall can you run a quick check on PR 4321? it touches dedicated autoscale roles.
eng-oncall (bot): deploy-check: PR #4321 — unit tests: pass; staging e2e: failing on scale test (timeout). status: needs-repro.
jordan (Eng): picking up the e2e failure now, looks like an internal wait condition under high concurrency. i'll try a fix and iterate; aim is EOD. fallback: gate behind feature flag to unblock pilot.
tyler (AM): timeline check — if they want a pilot this quarter we need rachel + eng sign-off by Thu. is that realistic?
emma (AE): main risk is PR 4321 timeline. if eng delivers hotfix today and rachel the one‑pager, we can lock pilot kickoff for Fri. i'll update the internal checklist and deck.
rachel (Security): one‑pager draft uploaded: https://redwood.share/kms-hsm-onepager — added a short diagram and recommended retention settings. please review.
leo (Solutions): copying the draft into the slide deck now. will flag any mismatches after the 11:30 call.
emma (AE): perfect. if anyone on sales needs the intake checklist or a short diff doc to send to KestrelPros, ping me and i'll share. End of check-in :rocket:
